activity_summary: The comedy was back from Blackfriars with Jacqueline's two words and no others. Nick put the mended vowel in the front of the mouth and did not invent a French line. You named Thursday's forty as a part and did not speak them. Kemp asked for the slippers and was given Thursday. You did not show him another book.

entities.name: Abel Garnish
entities.context: Entered the two words and stopped the shoes.

entities.name: Nick Sorrell
entities.context: Placed the breath before the vowel, and stopped.

entities.name: Augustine Phillips
entities.context: Praised the vowel once, and refused twenty bars that would become the dance.

entities.name: Arthur Meeks
entities.context: Named the short hem, and hung the kirtle.

entities.name: Will Kemp
entities.context: Asked for the slippers, was refused, and did not get a book.

entities.name: William Shakespeare
entities.context: Named the forty as a part, and left them unspoken.

entities.name: Love's Labour's Lost
entities.context: Mentioned in The vowel, and forty

facets.activity: Took the book back and kept the jig for Thursday

quotes.speaker: nick_sorrell

quotes.speaker: william_shakespeare
quotes.text: Thursday's book, for me, is an old duke and forty lines

quotes.speaker: abel_garnish
quotes.text: The leaf is entered as two words and no more
